reviews.text: Had a lovely Sunday roast — everything was cooked perfectly and full of flavour. The service really made the experience though. Evelyn and Ed were both fantastic: welcoming, attentive, and genuinely friendly without being overbearing. They made us feel well looked after from start to finish. Will definitely be back for another roast!

A gem in the middle of Mare street Hackney.
I can’t believe I’ve lived in Hackney for many years and have never visited this fabulous establishment.
What a wonderful place to meet for drinks ,warm and inviting, off the main road with a nice seating area outside . The staff were amazing especially Christobell . This lady was very knowledgeable , polite and professional. Christobell made our first experience of this public house a very memorable one , we will return.
We had a snack of halloumi fries they were delicious and they came with a lovely sauce. I’m looking forward to sampling some more from the menu, the kitchen area looked very clean.
This will definitely be my go to pub when visiting the Empire next door, or when meeting friends in the area .Highly recommended. Card only .

Fancied a roast so popped in here - was disappointed by the size, for £21 I expected more than two roast potatoes! It was nice, but nothing spectacular. The food was just generally a little bit lacklustre, but to be fair to them it was the end of a Sunday shift. Nice gravy. I would have said something because I was disappointed with the price versus the quality of the food, however the waitress didn't come to check on my meal, and it was busy at the bar so didn't want to go up and then leave my food to get cold. Overall atmosphere was nice and cozy though!

Stayed in the hotel as seeing a show at the Empire. Only got 10 rooms and its a narrow quirky hotel with winding staircases. Room was on second floor and nicely set out, with tea and coffee. Bathroom had over bath shower, which, for me, was difficult to access, no shower curtain or hand rails so water all over the floor after shower.
Bar had a lovely vibe and hotel guests were given discount on food and drinks. Staff very friendly and helpful. Would definitely book again, good value for money.

Came here to celebrate my birthday last Saturday night pre-MOTH club and had an amazing time! Despite having less staff than usual, Saffy and Rupert worked tirelessly to make sure we were looked after and made the evening really special. Huge thanks to the kitchen team as well, who went out of their way past their closing time to provide us with food. A great pub with exceptional service.

reviews.text:
We had a dinner party facilitated by David’s amazing team (Vy, Julio, and their amazing chef) The first time we solicited professionals for an elevated experience and unsure if the costs would merit.

Suffice to say, we were BLOWN away by Bistrotheques food, service and exceptional vision. They curated an entire *experience*, from canapés, to drinks to mains and dessert. Every guest left with glowing reviews.

If you’re looking for a premium experience then I recommend these fine people heartily. It’s worth an investment if you truly want something memorable.

Faultless service and a chic open kitchen bistro ambience. The highlights of our meal were definitely the steak tartare and the ginger sticky toffee pudding (that caramel sauce was insane). The burger was a bit overcooked and a bit of a letdown. Pleasantly surprised to find a chilled red by the glass.

The food here is lovely, a carefully curated menu that is executed perfectly! Everything we had was fresh and tasted amazing - please bring back the leek fondue pie as we couldn’t try it and I had so been looking forward to it. The service was absolutely lovely as well, everyone was very friendly and attentive - also the cocktails were fab and came out insanely fast! Only one thing I’d change, a bit of music would have made the atmosphere even better. But overall can’t wait to come back!!

We’ve been going to Bistrotheque for years and it’s become a real favourite of ours. It’s the place we bring friends and family, celebrate birthdays, and where we’ve spent New Year’s Day six years in a row. The food never disappoints, the service is consistently welcoming, and it somehow manages to feel both special and relaxed every time. We honestly couldn’t recommend it enough.

Everything we tried was great and interesting. Their staff were incredibly friendly as well. I’d recommend coming with a bigger group so you can try more from their menu, but their atmosphere is also great for couples. Will definitely come again!

super decent Sunday roast actually. well seasoned slices of meat. all well. seasoned with good roasted vegetables and very savory, had sirloin which tastes great and tender and would say that the only criticism would be that the potatoes were a bit tough for no reason. otherwise everything was pretty perfect and I would request sharper knives as we use butter knives to cut. otherwise everything was well recommended

No idea why the rating is low but the food is soooo good and service is wonderful. Went tonight and just really happy after!

Specials are always a good shout and the menu constantly changes. Make a reservation if you can as gets busy!

Update: pies are soooo yummy!! Can just get the one for 2 and not even need sides, really filling!! And amazing service as usual xxx

I went here for lunch on Saturday, a reccomendation from a friend. It was absolutely outstanding. We had meatballs with grilled taleggio cheese and the beef tartar to start. My friend had the Skate and I had the guinea fowl. We had to roll out of there - Brilliant food, brilliant service and brilliant vibes all round. We will be back!

Pretty outstanding experience. Everything you want from a pub: excellent food (the menu changes every day, they employ a head-->toe ethic so there's always something intriguing, new & delicious), lovely front of house staff with some unique cocktail options and good drafts, and a good, busy social atmosphere. Would not hesitate to recommend this place for a quick drink or a longer meal. 10/10

We arranged family gathering and daughter booked for us as she lives local. Great looking old style pub and ambiance. We ordered a selection of dishes, which I would describe a expensive tapas. Flavours all good and no real complaints other than I resent paying £14.00 for a few sliced up bits of salami and some small Cornichons. Meatball were great but again could have done with a few more. The small cod dish we ordered again tasty but for £28.00 no so sure it was value for money.
We ordered some chips to fill us up and i think maybe they had been given a triple helping of salt. They all got eaten but sure our blood pressure must have hit the roof during the experience. Luckily we had a great pint of Guinness to wash them down. Next time we visit we will drop in for a few pints as the Guinness was that good! but probably hit the street market if we are feeling hungry. Overall, a lovely meet up, and as I say food tasted pretty good but we all agreed a tad overpriced for the amount of food on offer. Staff we polite and attentive.

name: LARDO
address: Unit 3, 201 Richmond Rd, London E8 3NJ, UK

reviews.text: Went to Lardo today for a late lunch and really enjoyed it. They have a ‘worker lunch’ option from 12-4. Really good value for money and generous portions. Service was excellent and dishes well presented and very tasty. I’d easily come back. My only comment would be the tiramisu, could be improved. Apart from that, everything was spotless.

It’s a really nice wine bar and restaurant, with a very cosy atmosphere. The pizzas were quite good for value and it’s a lovely place to relax and enjoy good food. As a French person, I found the wine good, though the lower-priced options on the menu were quite expensive for what they were and not necessarily the best, but of course, that probably doesn’t reflect the whole wine list. I’ve only been there once, but it’s definitely a great spot to enjoy a warm, welcoming ambiance and a tasty meal.

I had dinner there recently, and it was well worth it. The welcome was warm and genuine, the kind that makes you feel the place takes hospitality seriously. The industrial-style décor works nicely, metal, wood, soft lighting, nothing forced, just a cool, coherent atmosphere.

I started with the sea bass crudo, which was excellent: fresh, clean flavours and spot-on seasoning.
Then came the pasta with fennel sausage ragù, simply outstanding. Perfectly al dente, rich, honest flavours, the kind of dish that doesn’t need any tricks to shine.

And their orange wine was a real highlight: aromatic, lively, with just the right tension.

All in all, a thoroughly satisfying dinner. I’m glad I tried this place.

They are amazing! We went there with a toddler, so it was a bit challenging but the waiter and the servers helped us a lot, in managing the table and making our toddler entertained. They were so helpful, kind and polite. We, my friend and her baby had fun a lot although he made a bit of a mess around. The food was amazing, we ordered beetroot salad, pizza, red wine and tiramisu. It was so delicious! Especially we lived tiramisu because it tasted closer to the original recipe with almond liqueur. We sat outside, the weather was amazing and everything was perfect. I would recommend this place to everyone!

New Yorker/New Jerseyan here- this place. is. it.

The mafalde is absolutely delectable. It is the simplest meal made up of a handful of ingredients but oh my— the freshness?? unreal.

The margherita pizza STUNNED with a classic cheesy, greasy (in a good way) finish, you really can’t ask for more. Even the vegan pizza was delicious, and a quick ricotta sub (i took olives off my half) made it the perfect meal.

Excellent vibes, both indoor & outdoor, & excellent food. Cannot recommend it more! Will be back xx

name: The Hemingway
address: 84 Victoria Park Rd, London E9 7JL, UK

reviews.text:
Not a good table!
It was good in that the food is good and the service was attentive. However I booked a week ahead and confirmed the day before only to be seated on a squished table for 2 opposite the gents toilet. Other,  nicer,  tables were free the whole time we were there. So no benefit to booking in advance…better to just turn up and choose your own table.  The waitress also took my wine glass before I had finished (I only had one as was driving) even though we called out…she didn’t hear us. We decided to move to another pub. I don’t want to complain and kill the vibe or be difficult (ask to move tables etc) and I always pay the service charge. I would just consider these things when looking for a Sunday lunch venue in the future.

I recently visited for supper and absolutely loved the relaxed, welcoming atmosphere of the pub. I chose the burger, which was genuinely delicious and beautifully cooked. The staff couldn’t have been better.

The only, very minor, downside was the lack of cask ale options, but that’s purely personal, as I’m a sucker for a Sussex Best. Overall, it was a fantastic visit and I’ll definitely be returning once they sort out the lack of Ales!

The service was great
The pub is very nice and it was quiet
We had a good time
We would go back

We went here for lunch before a festival at Victoria park.
Staff are very attentive, food is of a very good standard and plenty to choose from at the bar.
They specialise in handmade scotch eggs which are awesome.
Highly recommend this place.

The Sunday Roast was amazing and great value for money. Particularly the meats were high quality. Such a nice London pub that could be improved by the service. I tried to make a reservation for 1:00 pm but was offered 12:00 instead which is no big deal. Although I really don’t know why the staff have to say “We need the table back by 1:30” , it’s very annoying and an unprofessional and unwelcoming attitude in the hospitality business. Particularly as the next “reservation” according to the sign was for 3:00 pm and not for 1:30 anyway. At the end of the meal we were well fed and couldn’t manage a dessert which I think would probably be pretty good considering the high standard of the mains. We asked for Irish coffee and were told that the pub doesn’t do hot drinks? A pub not doing hot drinks? All in all the service wasn’t great but the food was amazing.

What a lovely pub. Friendly staff and punters. Great selection of beers and outside seating. Amazing thing about global warming is that we can all now sit outside in December with a beer. What’s not to love

I visited The Dove recently while walking through Broadway Market and honestly had a really great experience. It’s one of those proper traditional pubs that still feels authentic, but also fits perfectly with the buzz of the area. The atmosphere inside is warm, relaxed, and welcoming, and it’s a great place to stop whether you’re out with friends, on a casual day out, or just fancy a quiet drink.
The drink selection is excellent, especially if you like trying different beers and ales. There’s a really good variety on tap and behind the bar, and the staff were happy to give recommendations, which was appreciated. Service in general was friendly and efficient — you don’t feel rushed, but you’re also not waiting ages to be served.
The location is spot on, right in the heart of Broadway Market, so it’s ideal if you’re already in the area shopping or just exploring. It does get busy, especially on weekends, but that just adds to the atmosphere and shows how popular the place is. Despite that, it still feels relaxed and not overcrowded.
I also had some food while I was there and it was really decent — proper pub food, well cooked, and good portion sizes. Nothing overcomplicated, just solid, tasty food that goes perfectly with a drink.
Overall, The Dove is a great pub with a nice vibe, friendly staff, good drinks, and a brilliant location. Definitely somewhere I’d come back to again and would recommend to anyone visiting the area. 🍻

We came as a group of four and had an absolutely wonderful experience! We tried a wide variety of dishes, and every single one was fantastic — full of flavor, beautifully presented, and clearly made with care. The highlight? The signature burgers, limited to just 10 per day — an absolute gem! Bursting with flavor and totally worth it. Can’t recommend this place enough!

1 person behind the bar on a Saturday at 20:45. All the bartenders were beyond rude. They didn't know what a Mexican Mule was.

A lot of middle class wankers with fake corporate jobs with bisexual moustaches. A couple performatively playing chess in a corner.

The revolution won't happen in this place. Avoid at all costs.

The best gluten free fish and chips I’ve ever had. Made with gluten free beer batter, it was crispy and had so much flavour. Bonus that it came with homemade tarter sauce and mushy peas. My go to for gf fish and chips whenever I’m in London!

I mainly come here for the fresh oysters at the market. They are great, but the men who serve aren't so nice all the time, they have a "fake polite" energy that they exude. Also the tried to overcharge me, but I did the math of all the individual oysters I asked for, and said it should cost X price instead, so they had to reduce it. I'm not even a tourist, but they tried to make me fall for this trap; lucky I always check. For these reasons they don't get 5 stars from me, and seafood is my favourite cuisine.

I love the way they handle their fish.

It’s the one and only fishmongers in Broadway market, but the care and attention they give to the fish add so much freshness and flavour. All fish is handled with love.

Their selection of fish is impressive given that it’s a tiny place.

The fish is alway fresh and we’ll presented.

We love going there to buy something special to cook.

We bought fresh mackerel and monk fish today.

Only popped by at the oyster cart, yet.
Fun stop, extremely tasty oysters, favourite was the Irish Carlingford Oyster; fresh, juicy and with an almost green taste.
Focused shucking and a great atmosphere from the stroller parents to the runners stopping by for a quick protein fix.

Purchased a few dozen fresh oysters recently - some from Whitstable and a dozen from Jersey. Highly recommended.
Also got about 250g of seaweed.

A lovely fishmongers that have a range of seafood.
Very friendly and helpful staff.

Some of the best oysters i've had in london. I think the options depend on what time you come. I've come on a Saturday before and there were multiple types of oysters, ranging in price from around £3.50 to £6 each. I got a pricier oyster and it was unbelievably good. I came recently on a Thursday at 6 and the oysters were £2 each. They were still good but not as mind blowing. However the cheaper price made them a great deal. I specifically recommended picking up some oysters then sitting at the pub across the road to get a drink to wash them down with.

Just visited Green Papaya — a cosy spot serving incredible dishes packed with flavour.

🍜 Beef Phở — Slow-simmered for 24 hours, rich, aromatic and full of depth. The beef? Tender, juicy, perfection.
• 🥟 Pork & Seafood Spring Roll — Crispy on the outside, packed with flavour inside — a must-order.
• 🌿 BBQ Pork Belly Vermicelli Noodles — Crispy edges with a juicy centre, paired with nuoc cham dressing, fresh herbs, lettuce, cucumber & carrots — chef’s kiss.
• 🦀 Salt & Chilli Soft Shell Crab — Light, crispy, flavourful — addictive 😍
🍗 Salt & Chilli Chicken Wings — The perfect seasoned starter.
• 🥗 Green Papaya Salad — Light, citrusy, refreshing and fragrant with kaffir lime and a touch of honey.
• ☕🍹 Vietnamese Coffee — Sweet, strong, and the perfect way to end the meal.

Super friendly staff, generous portions, great prices.

My friend and I went to this Viennese restaurant in a rainy evening and we really like this place. Good food for example, Pho, especially suitable for friends after work. The atmosphere was great and the staff were friendly. It’s also located not far from overground station. Overall I’d recommend it to anyone who wants to experience authentic Vietnamese food.

We visited this Vietnamese restaurant today with the family and were delighted to see they’ve added barbecue to the menu. The food was excellent—our kids especially enjoyed the beef pho, salt and pepper squid, and the barbecue dishes. The service was outstanding, with staff always attentive and quick to clear the table. It was a truly pleasant dining experience, and we highly recommend everyone give it a try!

Really good value for money, and the portions are bigger than expected. The pho was the standout for me, the broth tasted clean and natural, without that heavy, salty vibe some places have.

I also enjoyed their salt & chilli BBQ dishes. The aubergine and soft-shell crab were full of flavour and great for sharing.

The team there were lovely and made the meal even better.

A real hidden gem in East London! Green Papaya instantly transports you to a cosy Hanoi eatery — warm lights, wooden tables, and the gentle scent of lemongrass in the air. The grilled pork and seafood vermicelli is my favourite — smoky, fresh, and perfectly balanced with fish sauce and herbs. The soft-shell crab is crispy perfection, and the pho tastes clean, comforting, and deeply satisfying. Everything feels homemade and full of heart. Friendly staff, fair prices, and truly delicious food — easily one of my go-to spots in Hackney!

name: Black Cat café
address: 76A Clarence Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 8HB, UK

reviews.text: I had a delicious meal at Black Cat Café! The staff were very friendly and accommodating, I loved all the vegan food, and thought it was great value for money! I appreciate the art and book shelves there too! Would love to return to try more of their cakes and sweet dishes!

Great and pleasant service, pleasant atmosphere, the food is great and portion size is large! The preparation takes a bit of time, so take it into account.
I took the cat breakfast as I was pretty hungry, but in retrospect the kitten breakfast would've been better for me, finished pretty stuffed!  Would definitely recommend and come back here :)

I had the best time going to this Cafe. The staff were incredible and so lovely! I had the pleasure of having the salad bowl and easy to say it was one of the best I’ve ever had, all was so tasty and the serving size was great. Such a nice environment with  a lovely decorated and spacious setting. The toilets were also very clean and the decor were lovely! Would 10/10 recommend if you’re looking for tasty vegan food 😊
Yummy vegan food, great matcha!!! I think one of the best on Clarence Road

Radical Comfort at Black Cat Café – Hackney Black Cat Café isn’t just a place to eat — it’s a statement. Tucked away on Clarence Road, this volunteer-run, not-for-profit café offers a warm, inclusive space where ethics and flavour go hand in hand. The vibe is unmistakably East London: mismatched furniture, zines on the shelves, and a steady hum of conversation from locals, artists, and activists alike.

The menu is 100% vegan and refreshingly affordable. We tried the seitan burger and the lentil shepherd’s pie — both hearty, flavourful, and deeply satisfying. The portions are generous, and the desserts (especially the chocolate cake) are rich without being cloying. Everything is made with care, and you can taste the difference.

There’s a strong DIY spirit here — from the rotating art on the walls to the community events and fundraisers. Staff are friendly and passionate, and the atmosphere is relaxed, welcoming, and quietly radical.

Whether you’re vegan or just curious, Black Cat offers more than a meal — it’s a space to connect, reflect, and recharge.

The staff were so accommodating and very helpful. The food was so delicious and big portions all four of us had such full bellies that we couldn't have desserts. The cocktails are yummy made perfectly. We are already arranging to go back soon. Thank you for a lovely evening

Just went here last minute after our midwife appointment at Homerton hospital. We went for the top reviews and how close walk it was from the hospital. It was during the lunchtime and was empty. We really enjoyed the food and the service. We would love to come back and see during the evening for the atmosphere and try their cocktails.

We visited Venerdi for my mum’s birthday with a large group, and it was a great experience overall. The staff were incredibly welcoming and patient, especially as my mum changed her order a couple of times. The service was excellent, and they provided plenty of space for our group, including room for a pram and high chairs for kids.

The food was good, though mixed. The stone-baked pizzas were fantastic, and the rosemary focaccia was delicious. However, the seafood spaghetti was too salty, and my mum and sister said they were very thirsty afterwards.
My ravioli, while filling, was a bit overpowering on the truffles. I ordered the strawberry lemonade, and it was different - it could use better balance as it was very sweet.

The atmosphere was lively but not crowded, with festive decorations adding a nice touch. I’d definitely recommend Venerdi for their pizza and friendly service!

Pasta was overcooked, 3 meatballs for £14
Spaghetti mare were drenched in tomato sauce and most of the shells were empty. Good Aperol spritz and decent service. Disappointed with the food, not authentic at all and seeing the food warmed up in the microwave was a huge disappointment.
Had a delicious meal, drinks were perfect and amazing service. A special thanks to Rachid for sorting us out!

The Empress is hands down one of my favourite pubs… it’s the perfect mix of relaxed, welcoming, and full of character. I love that it’s dog friendly, my dog absolutely loves coming here and always gets so much attention from the lovely staff and regulars.

The food is incredible every single time. I always go for the steak, it’s cooked to perfection, full of flavour, and easily one of the best around. And I can never resist one of their Bloody Marys! They make them just right, perfectly balanced and packed with flavour.

The atmosphere is always spot on, whether it’s a lazy afternoon or a busy evening. It feels like a proper local gem, friendly faces, great service, and a lovely buzz.

Lovely big family pub. Really enjoyed the roast, the beef was cooked really well and was of high quality. Veggies were also cooked perfectly. Friend’s vegan nut roast also hit the spot. Not as good as mum’s, but the sticky toddy pudding was delicious ;-) Would definitely come back with the extended family.

We arrived at the pub at noon when it just opened. It was spacious, clean, and very beautiful. Greeted by the lovely hostess, we sat by the window and took our time admiring the atmosphere. Nice selection of drinks. Food was great we had the padron pepper, steak, and cod.

Last night we celebrated a birthday and honestly, it was perfect. Our table was big and private enough for our party, but we still felt part of the buzzing, cosy atmosphere the place offers!

I have lived in the area for years, The Empress never fails.

The food was absolutely next-level. From starters to desserts, everything was executed beautifully. The chateaubriand was unbelievable and all the other dishes we had on the table were just super tasty, well seasoned etc.. absolutely no negative comment to report.

Service was amazing,  they were quick to swap cutlery and glasses and cleared empties (We had a lot of different bottles).

Everything ran so smoothly! it honestly made the night feel effortless. Great food and great service, that's literally all we wanted.

A massive shoutout to Becca, who was an absolute star. Ten out of ten, will definitely be back!

We booked The Empress for our wedding reception last week. Michael and his team were incredible. The staff at The Empress are so welcoming from the get go and nothing is too much trouble. We cannot thank them enough and would have no hesitation in recommending The Empress for any event whether that be for drinks, dinner or a special occasion - we are sure you will get the same incredible service every time. So we’d love to say a massive THANK YOU TO MICHAEL AND ALL THE EMPRESS TEAM 😘

❤️I am incredibly excited and happy because the restaurant has been taken over by someone who has managed a chain of restaurants of all sizes in the UK! I order online every night and usually eat at the restaurant every Sunday. All new menu and new flavors! Perfect! ❤️ The food is 10/10, 100% authentic Vietnamese flavor, the customer service is excellent, friendly, enthusiastic, attentive, and especially clean and tidy!! I highly recommend you come and experience it! 5 stars for quality ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️🙏

The absolute best bone broth in London.

I always get the Vegetable & Tofu with meat broth.

The noodle re glossy and perfect, not as sticky and starchy as other places, lighter.

Always the MOST veg compared to others.

A sweet delicate nutritious broth.

They were kind enough to give me a free dessert today because an I’m a regular. The sweetest family. Wonderful service and energy.

Best Vietnamese in Hackney BY FAR ✨✨✨

THANK YOU I LOVE YOU 🫶🏼

I used to come to eat in this restaurant very often a few years back. Since the manager has changed the price has gone up and the food quality has gone down.  I've just ordered a vegetarian tofu soup and the tofu  tastes like it's gone off, so I'm left to picking it out of the bowl. I've tried to call the restaurant but it sounds like the number isn't active anymore.  This is why I'm writing a review.  I would have preferred to talk to someone and explain the situation and stop them serving out of date tofu to other customers. I think this will be my last time I go to this  restaurant

So yummyy. We've been craving Vietnamese food as the weather got so cold. Nothing beats a hot steaming bowl of Pho pair with a strong Vietnamese coffee on the side. We took Takeaway home as well and its still tasted so delicious. Highly recommend if you're in Hackney!

I was really impressed with the mixed starter, it had great variety and was delicious. The half duck however was incredibly dry and we had to keep asking for more sauce. No prawn crackers was disappointing too.

Service was great and so was the atmosphere.

name: The Lauriston
address: 162 Victoria Park Rd, London E9 7JN, UK

reviews.text:
A very unassuming pub with some of the best pizza we’ve ever had! Great service great food and very reasonably priced

Would totally recommend when in the area.

Came by on two occasions, for a quick drink and for dining in. It was a very pleasant experience both times. I live in the area and often on weekends and evenings it’s difficult to get a seat because it’s such a popular spot, and for good reason! Staff is very friendly, food and drinks come out quick (and with good quality) and the area itself is very pleasant. Definitely recommend!

Lovely little boozer. Open 11am on Sundays. Pricey pint of Deya but where isn't it expensive these days. Looked like the whole place was booked out so clearly a popular spot - if you're going on a weekend I'd recommend booking. Nice people, good vibes, will return.

Lauriston Road Nisa Local has completely transformed, the new refurbishment is honestly the BEST in the area. The moment you walk in, you can see how much thought and care has gone into every detail. It feels modern, fresh, and incredibly well-designed. The whole store looks and feels like a premium shopping space while still being a friendly local convenience store.

The range is brilliant: from fresh produce to chilled, food-to-go, everyday essentials and treats: everything is beautifully presented and fully stocked. The team are always welcoming, helpful and genuinely take pride in their work.

This store has set a new standard for what a neighbourhood convenience shop should be. A real asset to the community and an absolute pleasure to shop in. Highly recommended!

Our favourite local pub for pizza and drinks. The best pizza I’ve had in London so far. We come here nearly every week to get the spicy salami pizza and a cocktail or pint. Great vibe, staff’s lovely and outdoor seating area is great. My friends love the vegan options.
Popped in for a steak sandwich, so pleasantly surprised by the quality of the meat! Soft, fabulously cooked, and well seasoned. Would gladly come back for another, highly recommended!
Not had a better steak in London for a long long time. Absolutely delicious. The wine was great too and for £41 you just can’t argue. A place to seek out and travel to eat at.
Very good food! Highly recommend coming to this place for amazing cuts of meat grilled well.  The service was great - very friendly staff.
An absolutely fabulous meal. Completely unpretentious, delicious food and great service. The steak is easily one of the best I've ever had. Don't miss it!

What an excellent evening of amazing food and wine with the best service from Andrea. She was so knowledgeable, shared her recommendations which we tried and loved. Who knew sweetbreads could taste like that?!
London has a lot of steak restaurants but this is up there with the best.

A great pub in viccy park. The food is actually really good - two of us had the chicken Shnitzel and have talked about it multiple times since. Proper wholesome food. We sat outside In Jan as many others were but it didnt feel overly cold as there are plenty of heaters. There were lots of people with dogs, we loved saying hi to them all. Was also child friendly! We will be going back for dinner and a quiz night in the future ☺️

Had my very first Sunday roast here and it was amazing! Great food, friendly service, and such a cozy place to spend the afternoon. The roast was cooked perfectly with generous portions. Highly recommend if you’re in the area!

Myself & ex-work colleagues met up as we often do for a meal & a chat. This was our first & probably last visit based on our experience.

It was chosen as an alternative to our usual spot, based on reviews.

I was greeted very well by a particular bar staff who also took our food order. She advised she would be leaving shortly (it was about 3-30pm). My party of 4 ordered the chicken dish served in a breadcrumb coating, egg & chips with a salad with dressing. Once served the dish, no member of staff came to check if the food was to our liking. The chicken coating was so hard, it knocked against the plate. We were so hungry, the only edible part was the chips & egg. We agreed collectively that it was the worst dish we ever had in a pub. Total cost of the meal was £20 per person. We complained & was offered a complimentary drink each. Nice gesture, but I would have preferred decent food.
I had a phenomenal Sunday roast, Nicky looked after us so well, great value and beyond exceptional service I will definitely come back. all of the staff were so lovely!

This is a lovely pub but much better on a quieter day. We came on a day that was way too busy. But the food in here is decent, the surroundings are lovely as you're in the park itself. It's dog friendly. But beware because of the crowds, it is a queue at the bar system, no table service. Which is fine, but just be aware of this before coming. I have been coming here for over 20 years and have seen the changes in this area and this pub. But I will always visit when I'm in the area as for me it's a part of my Eastend history.

It was an okay experience here but I can't say it was good. No problem with the staff or customer service they were all lovely but the food wasn't it. Croquettes tasted really dry and it only made it nearly good with the sauce next to the croquette, however the chicken was really nice. Just dont think the blue cheese dressing was a good fit for the chicken.

I was recommended this spot by a friend and I've just had a wonderful lunch here. The burger is DELICIOUS and I couldn't recommend it enough. They offered me some hot sauce with my meal which I later found out was home made by the owner!  It was amazing! What a touch! Really lovely staff, quick service and very nice vibe. (p.s. they sell the hot sauce in house...I bought two bottles)

I had a coffee on the patio and the staff we had was not very friendly at all. It felt like he was annoyed that we were asking for service. He was inpatient with us when we took a second to respond to what we wanted. He got us to pay right when he brought us the drinks which was totally fine. We asked to each get our own bills and he was visibly annoyed to do so. I got my bill and the total was written and there was a line that added an OPTIONAL service charge. The menu had stated that the tip was discretionary. Given the level of service I decided to give a 10% tip , which I still think is generous given the service I received, instead of the 20% it suggested on the bill given the attitude we got from the waiter. I gave him the money. Then the server came back and forced me to pay the full discretionary tip which I thought was soooo unprofessional and rude. When it said it was optional to pay that amount! I would never return here or recommend anyone to do the same. I also say him sternly telling other people off for moving the patio chairs to be in the sun. The whole situation just put me off. There are plenty of other places around and I would suggest going to any  other cute cafe.

A staple of the community. Market Cafe is one of those places that truly gets everything right. The service is consistently top tier — warm, attentive and genuinely welcoming.

I’m always a little hesitant now that we’re travelling with our four-month-old baba into social settings. Not all London restaurants are accommodating when it comes to little ones, but these guys get it right every single time. The demographic of the cafe is a testament to that.

People meeting parents. People on dates. People with babies. Girls’ lunches that have started with their first Prosecco. It’s all here at Market Cafe. They cater to the community in a way that feels genuinely unique — and uniquely Hackney.

The menu is varied, the quality of the food is outstanding, and the price point is incredibly reasonable for the area. And if you’re into a boozy brunch, their cocktails are delicious.

The atmosphere is relaxed and inviting, making it a true neighbourhood favourite and a key part of Broadway Market and London Fields. Couldn’t recommend it more.

Horrible attitude from staff, this place is everything wrong with what Hackney has become. No sense of community, respect or kindness. So many better places in the area, spend your ££ at other (cheaper) venues w better vibes, better food & no 20% service charge for horrible service lol

long-time customer of this underrated restaurant, staff’s very friendly and always serves fresh hot food. i personally love their kofte and garlic sauce

(we got lamb kofte this time, will try ribs next time)

location’s very convenient, right in the heart of hackney central

Long term customer here, multiple years with weekly visits.

Recently brought in the gourmet burger.
I've had my fair share of these and this is by far the highest quality I've ever tasted.

My first of many in this takeaway. ❤️

I was greeted by the wonderful bubbly personality that is radhika who kindly ran through the menu for me. After selecting lamb ribs they sectioned off a whole section of their grill and added complementary grilled veg to my order. They topped it off with the beautiful presentation by the chef/artiste that is (tari/leri/laki)

Very friendly with customers. It was my first time here but i've seen it before many times. I recommend going here for many reasons, one to name is their thorough and detailled breakdown of the menu. Additionally, the interior and quality of the food was very well done.

We ate Loaded Döner @ price of £6.99 per person.

Fantastic.

My first time ordering a take away kebab from bbq xpress and gladly surprised !
They have even proper tables inside so it is not just a typical takeaway place.
I also was very surprised with the professionalism of the staff. Super fast and super correct. Not very often one can say that…)
I haven’t tried the ones that are just next to them but to be honest, I don’t think I am going to give them a go!
Meat and vegetables were fresh and tasted superb! I will definitely come back!

Was sunny so I sat outside to relax after the Ronch exhibition. Looks nice inside, I haven't spent enough time to comment. The beer was crisp and tasty. The pub had a table with quirky recent event fliers, I took camden pop up fashion show that was on that day only.

🍺 £6.20 Paulaner

The Haggerston sits on the border between Dalston and Haggerston in Hackney, East London. The nearest station is Haggerston.

This pub dates back to 1802 and was originally called The Swan. It was rebuilt in the mid-nineteenth century, and the plinth at the top of the building still bears its former name.

Over the years it has operated under several names, including ‘Richmonds’ and ‘Uncle Sam’s’, before becoming The Haggerston in 2008.

This is a one-bar pub with rustic, traditional charm. The servery is to the right with a marble-topped counter. In the right corner sits the old Joanna; to the left, a DJ booth; and opposite are intimate pew-style booths. The decor includes a boarded floor, exposed brick walls, and an eclectic mix of photos, signs, and mirrors.

Upstairs is a function room, traditionally decorated and complete with its own bar. A standout feature for me was a superb black-and-white photo of the brothers who ran the pub for many years. At the rear is a partially covered beer garden, with more outdoor seating at the front.

The beer selection is excellent, offering premium lagers, local independent brews, and one cask ale from @fivepointsbrew .I went for a Paulaner, a personal favourite—top pint, average price. No food is served, but there are plenty of bar snacks if you’re peckish.

I arrived at 2pm on a mild Saturday in November. The pub was quiet, chilled, and set to a superb soul and jazz soundtrack. Service was first class; the team were friendly and personable. I even received a guided tour from the Guv’nor, who has been here for ten years and is an absolute gent.

This pub really comes alive at night, with live piano on Wednesdays and Thursdays and DJ sets on Fridays and Saturdays. A true institution here is The Alan Weekes Jazz Quintet, which has performed every Sunday for over 25 years.

A fiercely independent pub and a joy to visit. The beer is well chosen, the setting intimate, and the team here are some of the best in the business. I left this boozer with a big smile. I 100% recommend you visit.

Great pub with a credible music offer. Hence why we pitched our services and were politely declined. Can't blame a fella for trying. Best of luck in the world guys.

Always a good vibes here. Music is good, love the atmosphere. Does get super crowded sometimes and can be hard to manoeuvre around the dance floor. Bar as well can be a nightmare to queue up for. But - I do like this place and have been many times now!
Terrible rude bouncers Glenn and Mathew pushing people out in a very rude policing way without a reason. Shame cos otherwise it would have been a vibe.  Never coming back again

Delicious fresh seafood and great live jazz music! We had an amazing time and I would certainly come back.

The only negative I would say is the lack of ventilation.

What an incredible place. The seafood, the amazing service, the live jazz, the atmosphere. It was all on point. Such a unique experience and doesn’t feel like you are in London. We celebrated my birthday and after our dinner we were taken to the place across the street to continue the evening. The owner also sent us a bottle of sparkling wine and the waiter came in singing and dancing, even if no one had requested this! I had only mentioned that it’s a birthday in the booking. Such a gem of a place - I will definitely be back!

celebrated our friend's birthday here for dinner & were served a set menu that consisted of good seafood!

we had oysters, mussels, trout, haddock, & king prawns. 🦐 there were also peas & chips as sides 🍟, and cheesecake & carrot cake for dessert. 🍰

it was a warm night, so we were sat outside. the jazz music added to the atmosphere, although there were times when they took a break & it was quiet. still, excellent vibes! 🎷

the price of the food is pay as you wish, but they do have a drinks menu that you have set prices.

overall a good place for a meal in east london. would definitely come back again.

First of all, we thought we were going to the main restaurant, but we were led to another location across from it because there was no space, even though we had a reservation two months in advance. The atmosphere of the other place was completely different from the main restaurant. The jazz band was not the same, and it was too bright to feel like a jazz bar.

We had to pay a minimum of £30 per person. The menu did not state this minimum requirement, and we felt taken advantage of. Please avoid making the same mistake; this place clearly states its pricing policy is according to how you feel the food and experience are worth. The musicians told us they were not even paid a portion of what we paid.

The food arrived randomly (not in the order it appeared on the menu), and it took a while for all the dishes to arrive. We had to leave early because it was taking so long, yet we still had to pay £30. The seafood was nothing special; the flavours were bland and unexceptional. The oysters were not fresh which was concerning... I have had better seafood at home.

Oh, and the bread was stale and hard to bite into, so overall, would not go here again or recommend this to others.

Loved the atmosphere; the jazz was cool and the seafood was delicious and very good sized portions! We had the seafood tartare for a starter and it was delicious. We enjoyed the fresh oysters (could have done with more lemon but that's not a big deal) and the large portion of clams hit the spot. For the next course we got two very large pieces of fish in very tasty seafood sauce, potato and some of the best chips that I have had, to share between 4 people, which was definitely enough and delicious. The last course was tiger prawns which were very tasty as well and by then we were pleasantly stuffed.The only thing that we didn't enough so much was the cake for dessert which was very heavy and a bit claggy. But we went for the seafood and they definitely delivered! My hubby is allergic to shellfish and he had a bit of a wait for his fish course but it was worth waiting for and as it is a seafood restaurant we appreciated the staff were accommodating. It was a very busy service but the staff, though rushed off their feet were pleasant and courteous. All in all a very good experience and we would definitely return if we are in London again!

This bagel shop is a total gem. The bagels are perfectly chewy on the inside with just the right crisp on the outside—clearly made fresh and done right. The flavors are spot-on, whether you’re going classic or trying something more adventurous, and the cream cheese selection alone is worth the visit.

The staff is friendly, fast, and genuinely seems to care about what they’re serving. Even when it’s busy, the vibe stays warm and welcoming. It’s the kind of place that turns a regular morning into a great one. If you love bagels, this spot is a must.
Bagel on the Park nailed it – creamy oat milk chai, a killer chicken & bacon baguette, and a crunchy, chocolatey cannoli that was pure heaven. Bliss from first sip to last bite! Delicious

What a wonderful establishment. Perfect for a hungover day, we consumed 13 bagels between 8 of us and they definitely hit the spot. Very efficient service and not badly priced either. 100% would recommend.
Been seeing this place on my walks but recently started going in and honesty it became my comfort food! Soo delicious, the coffee is great and ladies working there are always very nice! 1000/10 ❤️

Attentive staff, very welcoming!
Love their salmon and cream cheese bagel!
Do visit! Everyone is soo nice in here

Lovely Georgian place, with all the traditional delicacies!!
Very tasty food and friendly staff!
The do not sell alcohol, but you can by lovely Georgian wines from across the street!!
Great value for money!!!

My veggie friend & I shared the Khachapuri, the mezze board and aubergine rolls, all of which were delicious!! Especially the cheese bread. We also had the honey cake as a dessert which is a must if you visit. BYOB is also a nice touch.

The team here were also really lovely and accommodating. Looking forward to visit again and trying some of the meat options!

I recommend booking as the restaurant was super busy and they had to turn away several walk ins whilst we were there.

Just to set the scene I came at 9:45pm, 15 minutes late for the last reservation on a gloomy Wednesday evening, the staff were more than kind enough to still serve us; And serve us they did. Me and my boyfriend agreed it was one of the best meals of our lives. From the produce to the skill and love put in to the food, it’s clear this establishment will deliver rain or shine. If you are reading this review and deciding whether you want to go an eat here the answer is yes and everything on the menu

Outstanding and authentic Georgian food. They have all the main dishes like hachapuri, khinkali, lobio, and also some of the more meat-based. The place is small and operates well for walk-ins. Bring your own bottle (BYOB)

Great food.  Good value.  The Haggerston branch is BYO with an off licence across the street that stocks Georgian wine.  There is a corkage charge of £5 per bottle.  Quiet, civilised atmosphere for a BYO on our visit.  Pretty panelled room results in good acoustics.  Upstairs is a small room, with tables close together enough to follow neighbouring conversations.  Booking by telephone recommended because it is very popular.

We started with the rich open cheese boat bread.  Until we watched the slavic speakers at the next table we didn’t realize you are meant to stir the runny egg and melted cheese together before tearing apart the flakey loaf.  The roast aubergine salad with walnuts and pomegranate seeds as well as the chopped mushroom and onion starters were both terrific accompaniments.

We shared one main of the pork and beef dumplings.  Large and and somwhat doughy due to their size.  Tasty, and containing a little broth inside along with the meat but I think I prefer daintier Chinese shiao long bao.  We didn’t finish the dumplings and it was no problem getting a takeaway box as well as instructions for best warming up the leftovers.

We definitely plan to return to try more of the menu.  A light dinner for two was £70.
Good fried rice

Best special fried Singapore noodles I’ve had in a while… crispy seaweed was cooked perfectly too. And the driver was so sweet and polite. Definitely ordering again. Please don’t change your recipe/ ingredients or chef ^_^.

I fancied chinese food lastnight so I went to this restaurant listen if you want proper cooked fresh Chinese come to this shop well cooked non greasy nicely seasoned I will definitely come back here. The lady who served us was so cool my new go to.

Best fried rice in Hackney (and I've tried many) It's actually fried, brown and seasoned well.... and not just plain white rice with veg some peas thrown in it. The rest of the dishes are typical UK Chinese  standard. Friendly and reasonable prices.

My new favourite Chinese in East London! Ordered the Salt and Chilli Prawns and the Sweet and Sour Prawns, both great as well as the egg fried rice and noodles. Delivery took around 40 mins (they quoted 35) and they forgot my curry sauce, but delivered it shortly after. Minor issue, will definitely order again!

name: Swift Caribbean Delights Takeaway
address: 27 Homerton High St, London E9 6JP, UK

reviews.text:
First time eating here and absolutely blown away by the taste! I enjoyed every mouthful and would happily go back but I feel like I wouldn't stop! Definitely a must try, I will be going back again. Great customer service from The Hulk serving the food, chatty and engaging whilst waiting for the food. A* in my book. Looking forward to my next visit.

My food is mixed, chicken pasta, callaloo and pumpkin...? I forgot. But will definitely have them again!

I see this restaurant often and I am always happy to see them open. I have never used them personally but this store is usually busy, when open. Very good sign. I also wish they had another location so that I could park and maybe sit inside when they are open. This store is endorsed by uniformed persons..very often. I do hope they continue the good work- that they do. Well-done!!

Used to visit here frequently, and it’s gone very downhill since. Went in on a Thursday evening around 6:30pm - most dishes out of stock. Had to repeat myself 3 times because the guy taking my order wasn’t listening, even though I was the only customer there. Ordered BBQ chicken, completely inedible. Literally a portion of bone and grizzle, no edible meat - full thing went in the bin. Rice and peas were decent, but this doesn’t make a full meal. Really disappointing, will be looking for a new local.

Three of us were looking for curry in the middle of the afternoon.  Most restaurants were closed.  We came upon Swift thankfully.  The music, the aromas, the beautiful smile and reception were a blessing.  We love caribbean food and we were not disappointed.  Yummy curry goat, chicken and pumpkin stew!  We're from Montreal and will look forward to this place the next time in London.  chhers!

Went before Tottenham's champions league match with my sons, the food was fantastic had the jerk chicken and rice with Guinness Punch,  BBQ chicken wings and curry goat  both with rice.friendly atmosphere and attentive service.

name: Chambers Restaurant
address: 132 Lauriston Rd, Victoria Park Rd, London E9 7LH, UK

reviews.text:
We had a table for 12 to celebrate my sisters 60th Birthday. The food was fantastic, the staff are so friendly and welcoming, they make you feel like they know you. We ALL had an amazing time. They let us bring in a birthday cake. They even cut it all and served the cake as desert, therefore lessening the total bill. This was totally unexpected as we would have ordered a dessert.
We loved it so much that we booked a table for 12 for Xmas day.

Amazing family that includes all who walk in the door.  Food is delish. My faves are the Chamber's salad, the warm salad ,the 4 cheese pizza, Sunday roast,  the tiramasu! Good wine selection.  Great cappuccino.  Lovely after dinner shots.  We were there for our 40th anniversary and they made an announcement to the whole restraunt and then turned up the music and we all danced!  Ada and Luka are the best hosts ever!  And their children are just as sweet.  Love this place!

My boyfriend and I had the loveliest meal here on Sunday! Everything about the experience was perfect! The food was absolutely amazing.

I also have to say… I had the BEST chai latte I’ve ever had! The owners were so lovely and welcoming.

Can’t recommend this place highly enough — we’ll definitely be back!

I visit Chambers at Victoria Park often it’s a great traditional family-run restaurant an absolutely nice place to chill.

Seda is such a warm, attentive, and kind host who always makes my friends and I feel welcome.

The marinated chicken wings and borek filo parcels are my favourite; always cooked perfectly. The chef is so consistent.

Recommended !!!

Amazing food!! Great place for breakfast or lunch!! Pasta was delicious. And we even got chocolate cake and tiramisu on house, which are must try!! As a vegetarian it was difficult to find good food anywhere, but here it was very easy. Saadah was very sweet and friendly. So was the ohter owner, must recommend place.

We went to the bakers to buy bread to get it sliced in store
We waited no one was there
Theres a time lapse between shifts aparently had to wait too long
We left the store and returned
The guy cutting the bread didnt wear gloves while handling the bread
The store isnt at all welcoming the staff lack in thankyou the ones we came across
No one seemed interested
Even on the till the cash option wasnt working
Eventually we was told after waiting a while
Its a shame we love m&s
We wont be rushing back

⸻

I am writing this review to warn other customers.

There is a consistent and recurring issue with price discrepancies in this store. The shelf prices are often lower than the prices charged at the checkout. This has happened on almost every visit, so it cannot reasonably be described as an occasional mistake.

I have raised this matter with staff multiple times, yet no lasting action seems to have been taken. This practice is misleading and creates a lack of trust.

Customers should be extremely careful to check prices and receipts before paying.
Love this place. Great food & staff. Shop is always clean and well organised.
An elderly woman I know is coming here with her disabled daughter. A short while ago, they accused her of theft and are not letting her in. This is slander and very cruel.

Visited to buy some lunch for an event I was going to the next day Friday.  All sandwiches and lunch bowls was dated for the same day Thursday, hardly any was dated for the next day.  A packer was packing out the food stuff so mentioned to him, he said yes that's correct and the prices will be reduced later on in the evening.  Why don't m&s make their sandwiches and lunch boxes dated for the following day or so rather than the same day. Apart from that shop was clean and tidy and staff was helpful and friendly.

name: Brazilian Centre HACKNEY - Produtos Brasileiros (Brazilian Products)

reviews.text: Wow! It was cool to see a specialty butcher and products from Brazil, Portugal and other countries. There were cakes, beans, frozen products and so much to choose from. I felt like I was overseas. It's a great little shop. I'll definitely be back.
Best salgadinhos in London! Love this place, the products are great quality and the service is excellent. Delicious food and lovely people - a little slice of Brasil in east London.
Great selection of Brazilian and Latino goods. The Argentine picanha was perfect!

Very friendly brazilian butcher! I bought 1kg of picanha and my flatmates were impressed by the cut! Can't wait to go back and pick the essentials and a good cut of meat this store has all you need for a legendary barbacoa. Obrigado!!!

Quality of their products and meat have decreased so much this year, to top it all of now they're selling expired goods. Bought a cake mix today (03/11/23) that expired in September 2023. They're asking me to go back to return the item instead of delivering a new one, next time I'll add extra time in my day to return their expired products.

Had the best dinner after a big walk around London with our dog so it was even better that they were dog friendly! Raju and sufail were incredible. We will 100% come again. Id recommend the pork ramen and the cauliflower bits. Amazing x

The chili chicken ramen was bursting with authentic flavors, and the chicken kara-age was perfectly crispy and delicious. The ginger soda was a refreshing, one of the best I’ve tasted! What truly elevated the experience was Raju’s exceptional service. He was attentive, friendly, and went above and beyond to ensure we had a fantastic dining experience. The atmosphere is great, and I highly recommend this place for anyone craving amazing ramen and top-notch service!

Food was lovely we really enjoyed our ramen. The broth was so flavourful and the noodles had a lovely chew to them still. We had the prawn & the classic tonkotsu. Also tried the gyoza which were tasty too.

Such amazing food, great portion sizes. Had a small bowl of their veggie tofu ramen and was thrillllled. Their sides and apps are incredible too, and great happy hour deal. Our servers Sufail and Alisha were literal icons, love them so much

Had an amazing meal at Tonkatsu in Hackney Central! I tried their signature prawn ramen and my husband had the chilli chicken ramen, both were absolutely delicious. The lemonade and ginger soda were super refreshing too.

Big thanks to Mr. Raju and the whole team for their lovely service. They were so friendly and made us feel really welcome. Highly recommend this place if you’re craving some tasty Japanese ramen! 🍜💛

This is just a small pic of Lentils special vegan, which I mostly ate because it was delicious. I served it with salad to stretch it out for 2 portions, as it's generous enough for 2 with side salad or veg. It's absolutely delicious. I have also tried Bean feast, and the vegetable curry. They are absolutely yummy, and feel healthy. It's my Saturday treat, so I don't have to cook. Worth every penny, and cheaper than buying takeaway, and millions times better. Highly recommend. I buy the range from Wholefoods Market Clapham junction. That's a nice shop too!!!
Thank you Rachel, I love your food.
Debbie x

I wanted to love this brand but unfortunately this is my 2nd time trying it and the food being inedible. The Aubergine "pancake" the pancake was soggy/wet and not really a pancake and the smoked mozzarella pasta is basically pasta with mayonnaise and some small bits of mozzarella, too tangy and couldn't eat it.

Had placed an order on their website and tried a few dishes from Laura & her, ... ever so friendly Son Robin. *LoVe all the flavours! *LoVe that their food is NOT overcooked at all (like most other places’) ... and indeed still alive and ‘al dente’. The customer service I’ve received was ‘second to none’ from Robin himself and Steve the delivery man arrived quite early and was very friendly indeed. I couldn’t be happier with my order and defo ‘HIGHLY’ recommend anyone who’s health conscious to try out Laura’s Idea for themselves. ‘You’ll be in for a very tasty treat indeed!’ Ps: my so far ... and probably all time favourite from Lauras Idea is still the extremely yummilicious  ‘Vegetable Calzone!’ ♥️
8 ⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ out of 5 stars from me Laura & Robin! Many thanks & the very best of Luck! xx

All sorts of great vegetarian dishes freshly prepared and tasty as.
Love the pesto pasta 🤤
Wonderful selection of products. Best vegan options in London

Portion size is generous and chips passable, but both chicken quality and crispy coating is mediocre.

I write this as a die-hard KFC fan… knowing that high street chicken shops are invariably weak in comparison. But we can always live in hope, right?

If my review and photos were helpful please leave a thumbs up 👍 Thanks!

That's a chicken fillet burger not a strip burger. Almost no chicken inside taste and smells terrible and chips look like they're re heated few times a day. Disgusting and ended in a bin after two bites. I'm sure good reviews are business owne s or friends

AVOID. I randomly walked in here for a quick lunch. They served me this half cooked chicken, which I only realised after eating a bite.

When I told the young man who served me, he said its perfectly fine!

I threw the rest of the burger in the bin and ate the chips.

Now I feel unwell with an upset tummy.

I had a great experience at Dixy Chicken! The food was fresh, hot, and full of flavor — especially the crispy chicken burgers and spicy wings. The staff were welcoming and served everything quickly, even during a busy time. The restaurant was clean, and the prices were reasonable for the quality. It’s definitely one of my go-to spots for a quick, tasty meal. Highly recommend for anyone craving good chicken!
I ordered a BBQ chicken pizza & BBQ wings.The food was fresh & amazing.The guy who made my food was polite,welcoming and accommodating. 😊

reviews.text: Overall, fantastic authentic Thai food. Having lived in Chiang Mai for 7 years, this is the closest I have had to real Thai food outside of Thailand. Location is a few footsteps from London Fields Station. Small branch with only 8 tables or so. Staff all polite and helpful but unfortunately understaffed. Only 2 slight negatives, kitchen is right by the tables so you will leave smelling of food, not a real issue, and quite pricey. Albeit the portions are huge, and I mean huge, our meal cost £93 for 2. Prawn crackers were delicious, very large portion and realistically enough for 4 person as a light starter snack. Satay was ok, but not exceptional. Thai squid was delicious, light batter with a salt/pepper/chilli coat, a must get starter. Pad Thai portion was huge! It only comes as a main meal, would be ideal if there was a small side plate version but absolutely delicious nonetheless. Penang curry was also fantastic and also the morning glory is another must order (although the leaf from the vegetable was removed which is the best part). Star of the show for me was the Thai holy Basil pork belly, exceptional taste, and spicy as it should be!! Although the pork belly would be crispy when ordered in Thailand, the meat was incredibly soft so it was just as good. Overall I would recommend Rosa’s however, do not over order ad the portions are huge and the bill will also be the same!!

good food and friendly service. drinks were great too (the lychee spritz is amazing).
it was SO cold inside the restaurant tho :(

Got the lunch special today and my taste buds exploded with all the flavors! 🤯😍✨ Incredible food, great and very friendly service and although the dip sauce for the corn fritters is apparently not listed in their cookbook (secret recipe 😭) I will buy it! 😁
Highly recommend you come here and taste your way through the menu!
I‘ll definitely be back soon 🤩🙏

I placed an order and what arrived was an absolute mess. The curry containers leaked badly, soaking through the paper bags and dripping everywhere (on my hands, the floor, and the kitchen counter). The bag was so drenched it was falling apart at the bottom from the moment the delivery guy wanted to hand it over to me.

What’s frustrating is the complete lack of thought that went into the packaging. You don’t pack food for delivery the same way you do for someone picking it up and going for a stroll. Delivery requires extra care: sturdier packaging, double-bagging, leak-proof containers, or at least a protective layer to contain any spills. None of that was done here.

To the store manager: I’m upset by this experience! You’ve failed big time, shown carelessness and a disregard for how food traveled from your kitchen to me as your customer. I spent so much time cleaning up my kitchen and the hallway, whilst trying to save as much food as possible. As such, I lost appetite because it’s hard to enjoy a meal when it arrives in such chaos. I won’t trust your place ever again!

A real gem!

Situated in the railway arches under London Fields station this place was a great find.

The humble surroundings hide a fantastic kitchen which serves up authentic Thai dishes served hot and fast.

We decided immediately on leaving that we are going back in the next few days....

Lovely spot - had brunch here and enjoyed the selections they had. Affordable as well which is a great feature. Smoked salmon was fantastic and got the pistachio cookie, highly recommend. Was busy when we got there around the early afternoon but wasn’t too long of a wait. We did have to sit out in the cold for a bit prior to having seats available inside. More available seating opened up around mid afternoon. Would come back again.

Cute cafe with more space for tables than one would assume standing outside their door! We were served by a really nice lady, everyone greeted us when we entered. We ordered lunch and the portion sizes were absolutely fitting. Good prices as well. Thank you!

Visited for my friends birthday and we were very impressed!
The staff were incredibly attentive and friendly, they even surprised us with a complementary cake.
The food was sooo good (the hash browns!). Everything was cooked perfectly and packed with flavour. The presentation was also beautiful.
We sat outside which created a really nice atmosphere. Overall a fantastic spot for brunch.

The customer service is excellent! Elif was great - kind, helpful and friendly. She explained the menu and made great recommendations on what to eat. I will recommend this cafe to my friends and will be returning. The vegan breakfast is delicious, especially the hash browns. The food came very quickly.
We had the most beautiful breakfast here! We are from Melbourne and this is one of the best coffees we have had!!! The med eggs 10/10 and the staff were so lovely! A must visit

Absolutely disgusting! Food arrived extremely late and restaurant was impossible to contact to chase the food. Not only was the food poorly presented the meat tasted disgusting- we threw the whole order away  (£25 worth) as we were highly concerned about the quality of the meat. Just eat contacted them on our behalf as we couldn’t get through to complain. They refused to refund money but did offer a free dish with our next order- we will NEVER order from this restaurant again. Just eat recommend we contact the local council to report concerns of food quality. 1 star is far too generous rating for this restaurant! Absolute awful experience from start to finsh!

Horribly rude delivery driver, threatened that if we ever ordered from them again but did not answer our phone then they would not deliver.  Unsure why they think this attitude is acceptable when, if I have paid for something and its delivery (card payment) then I expect  to receive it.

The driver was also late.

Will be spending my money elsewhere in future as all I wanted was a Chinese, not a nasty attitude from their delivery driver.

Horrific experience. Ordered at 1am, they said it would be delivered at 2, still nothing by 2:30 despite calling multiple times. They answered first time and then decided to ignore my calls until showing up at 4am and still charging me for the order!! I've spent time and money on expensive calls chasing a refund today.

Utterly horrendous food and service. Ordered at 7 arrived at 9 over 45 minutes after their predicted arrival time (slow as it is). Food was cold and even after reheating one of the dishes was so salty it couldn't be eaten. Food all had to go in the bin which is exactly where the restaurant should go.

Late! Took much longer than time stated on just eat. Called them when in was 5 mins overdue and was told the driver will arrive in 5-10 mins meaning the order will be with me 30 mins late. I hope it's only 30 mins late: seems it will be longer.

Great place for lunch at really affordable prices and nice coffee.

The lamb sausages with mushrooms are really good, as well as the hummus.

Relaxed atmosphere where you can come read a book in the afternoon and chill.

Thank you for providing diners with real, reusable mugs, dishware, and silverware.

By 2050, there will be more plastic in the ocean than fish. And over 95% of the plastic that we produce and consume does not actually get recycled. But rather ends up in landfills, incinerators, and our oceans.

As a customer, it means a lot to me to be able to support local businesses that are helping us to our part to be better to this earth. So keep up the great options!

One thing I was sad to see was the sale of plastic bottled water here. I wonder if you might consider switching to aluminum canned water, or water in glass bottles. The normalization of single use plastics has numbed us all to our overconsumption of it, and it would be really cool to see businesses fighting back against the plastic pollution crisis by limiting the sale of the stuff in the first place.

Thank you for considering, and thank you for the wonderful food and service. And for of course, offering a relatively trash-free meal!

I love this cafe, the hummus is especially delicious and better than I've has anywhere else. The staff are nice and the atmosphere is good. It's slightly off the beaten track, so it's a quiet location.
Definitely recommend popping in if you're in the area.
Very calm and warm place. I love my chai latte the food is delicious. It was so hard to hesitate and not try the cakes. They looked delicious. Love this place

Been wanting to come by here for so long, visited yesterday with some friends and had a nice time :))

Cool spot in London fields, nice atmosphere, good music, interesting artwork / photography. They also put on live music nights, and other events there

The food was delish, good size portion and have a few vegan options for me, which was perfect. I had the falafel box + my friends had the lamb box. The babaganoush was 10/10 too!

The guy working there was so nice and friendly, gave me a food top up for free and let us chill there for a bit after closing time

Definitely worth stopping by if you're in the area

Right let’s get this straight, you walk in not expecting much. This humble appearance is just masking one of the best places in the area. Quality pizza, thin crust amazing dough perfectly cooked… open till really late, perfect for a late night pizza. The guy running it was an absolute gem, super nice and I’m still thinking about how good it was today!

Probably one of the worst pizzas i’ve ever tried. Absolutely terrible.

I live 10mins from the place and it took over an hour to come. It really wasn’t worth the wait.
DO NOT waste your time or money.
Honestly surprised the funghi pizza was delicious, ingredients tasted fresh and high quality, dough is crispy how I like it, fair priced
Honestly fantastic - great pizza and a solid range of sides, open late and brilliant quality. Would hugely recommend!
Very nice Pizza 🍕 delicious 😋 and customer services was exceptional

We attended Yori Sushi once again for a birthday iftaar.
Munni assisted us with so much care and made sure that our food was ready on time for iftaar. She is a star 🌟

My favourite is the dragon roll. So delicious and full of flavour and is a must try dish here. We also love the rice dishes.
Portions are very good and filling using the finest and freshest of ingredients.

Once again the food was absolutely delicious, every dish we ordered was received with professionalism and care decorated beautifully.

The ambience is always so nice and peaceful.

I would highly recommend this place if you are after delicious food and excellent service.

Munni was very kind and took lovely pictures creating beautiful memories for us.

Looking forward to visiting this gem of a place again soon InshaAllah

Thank you ❤️

Perfect. I’m very picky with food I eat but this place actually so good I wanted to try everything and it was great I got so full though. But definitely recommend. The staff aswell very nice, very welcoming and you’ll never know what you get at the end of it.

Really cute restaurant, lovely service, but the food was ... spectacular.

We loved the dragon roll the most. The bao buns were also perfection. The food came quickly and presented beautifully. I noticed several local customers coming in to order takeaway. My new favorite sushi place in hackney and I'll definitely be back and ordering again soon.

such a good sushi spot! i had a wonderful experience here. munni was so kind and attentive, and made us feel so welcome. the food was amazing, the dragon roll was fresh and flavorful, and the pad Thai was just as delicious. great service and great food, definitely a spot I’ll be coming back to!
Great service great food, big thank you too affa helping me pick out a meal, first time trying it hoping to be back soon to try another dish.
