reviews.text: Our most regularly used local bakery, so it’s clearly doing something right. Nice selection of breads and pastries alongside a covered outside area for coffee and snacks. Probably not quite operating at the level of when it was the Danish Bakery (and no longer also trying to be a deli) but still a great place to get fresh sourdough.

Consistently bad service. Chances of being able to order hot food are slim to none depending on how good or bad of a day the server is having.

It’s not like the area has a drought of bakeries so save your time and money and go elsewhere

Great pastries and service
Big selection of fresh baked goods. Sourdough bread is 👌
It has a nice terrace for eating or drinking your coffee.
They also do lunch specials, and have juices.
Be aware they only take cards (due to covid)
I’ll
Be back I’m always back’
One really good breakfast pastry is the bacon Danish roll that also has some chili jam inside
Try or, good for kids as well, very friendly and on a quiet street

Went on the recommendation of friends as we were doing a “bakery tour.” Sadly, we couldn’t really sample their bread as it was sold out, but we did get a couple of sandwiches, so we know what their rolls are like. The lamb sandwich was fine not earth shaking. It is served warm, but by the time mine got to me, the cheese was no longer melty… maybe stand by to collect yours, if possible… Interesting lightly pickled veg inside and spilled out onto the plate. The sausage sandwich was served cold, and ready to go from the counter was pretty good!

The environment is very serviceable. We did take some buns with us for later, these people know what to do with flour and water and sugar!

The “pot” of tea didn’t feel like a value, but the tea was better than average. The latte was nice smooth coffee with just the right amount of milk and a nice foam on top.

INSANE pain suisse. Trust me (I go at least once a week). After trying all the bakeries & coffee shops in the London Fields, Hackney Central and Cambridge Heath areas, Snapery East remains the best one.

name: Elephant Hackney
address: 43 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 0NS, UK

reviews.text: Really loved the vibe of this place super relaxing and chilled, restaurant lit by candlelight. Have a really nice variety on the menu and everything we got was delicious and packed with flavour. The staff were super friendly and helped us decide what to order, our favourite had to be the tomato pasta dish, we love a big bowl of tasty pasta and the bread and date butter was out of this world!! very reasonably priced cocktails that great. make sure you add this to your list and make sure you pre-booking before you go as they were quite busy.

Love it here so much! Been a few times and it’s always great service, great food and the best vibes. Cocktails are very good, get the dirty martini or just ask the staff what they recommend and they’ll bring you something delicious. We spent between £35-£55 pp each time and got wine for the table, 1-2 cocktails and shared plenty of food. If you want something affordable but high quality then I can’t recommend enough.

Wow… what an incredible restaurant! All the food was phenomenal, my favourites were the sea bass crudo, steak and the pizza (i mean everything else on the menu was superb). The atmosphere and vibe throughout the restaurant was so lovely & homey. Will definitely be back again soon.

Thank you to the whole team for making our evening so fabulous ❤️

Maybe it is unfair to review a place during their soft launch.  I am sure a lot of the front of house problems during our visit are teething issues that will get sorted out.  Staff seemed overwhelmed by how busy it was during the discounted soft launch period.  There was one waiter who was really good, and concerned about reporting problems to management or the kitchen.  But most of the girls were just indifferent to the customer experience.  We waited a long time standing beside the bar before anyone asked about our booking.  And I am on crutches because I had a knee operation a few weeks ago.  When a waitress brought my companion’s main she just plonked a wonky plate of fish served in broth on top of the empty salad bowl his starter had arrived in.  She had to be called back and persuaded to take away the salad bowl his main was balancing on.

Portion sizes are a little weird.  The protein based dishes seem to be very dainty, whereas as the carb heavy ones are really large.  I started with the octopus skewer which consisted of two pieces of octopus, maybe 3 cm square each for £10.  It was delicious and tasted of charcoal though, and came with salsa verde and grilled pepper.  I ordered the sea bream crudo which never arrived.  The neighbouring table had an order which looked quite small.  My companion’s fish of the day of lemon sole was small too. On the other hand, the portions of pizza and pasta arriving at other tables looked enormous.  I had a pizzette which was generously sized and tasty.  Unfortunately I could not discern any of the mussel pesto that was listed in the menu as one of the toppings.  I loved the thin but soft crust.  My companion's starter of summer salad would have been good if it hadn't been so salty as to be almost inedible.

When I complained about not getting the sea bream crudo, the waitress who took my order just shrugged and said she thought I had cancelled.  I complained again to the decent water who checked, noted it had arrived to the dining room but had been sent back and offered me a slice of complimentary tirami su by way of apology, seeing I hadn’t gotten much to eat. This was a very generous portion, like all of the carby dishes.  It was let down by the quality of the espresso used in it's construction, which was very sour.  This surprised me for a restaurant where the head chef is from Naples.  I mean, the espresso could have been an Americano boiled down to espresso strength--that's how sour it was.

After I got home I notice we had been charged for two pizzettas when we only had one.  So definitely check your bill before you leave.

Me and my partner dined here last week and had such a great meal! Stevie has designed this space really well making it a cosy and gorgeous place to eat, big highlight is the ceiling
All staff members were lovely and so knowledgeable too!
We chose the house pickles and a few starters (croquettes were ace) and then two pizzas (diavola and the one with anchovies yum) all so well seasoned and the dough has a great doughy texture with a good bite.
I’d been craving tiramisu for ages and this one hit the spot
Big up Elephant🐘

name: Goppa' Restaurant&Pizzeria
address: 106 Homerton High St, London E9 6JA, UK

reviews.text: Great pizza, amazing starters, nice atmosphere and good prices too. Definitely a place everyone should discover
Small independent Italian pizzeria, run by Italians, very good pizza and cozy atmosphere. Usual prices for pizza in London, but you can't go wrong with the quality!
Tiny place, lovely staff. Pizzas are very nice here. They also have interesting selection of pasta.

This pizzeria is on my doorstep and always wanted to pop in.  Should have come before. Nice atmosphere,  friendly good service, good food and wine. What more can we ask for? I have my own restaurant so I can be picky and critical, but this did not disappoint at all. Well done.
The starters took a little longer to arrive than expected but it was busy so I'll allow for that. When the braseola arrived I thought wow.. I didn't expect that generous a portion. Overall an enjoyable meal. Thank you. Will go again.

I want to start saying that the pizza is really good. I gave for star because of the location and the atmosphere. The location is not great, in front of a busy road. Moreover, when we arrived there was no one inside and the music was loud and unpleasant. they didn't turn it down while we eat there. The turned it down only when an old couple came in. In summary, was a wired experience but the food was delicious.

name: Yard Sale Pizza
address: 105 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 0NP, UK

reviews.text: The crust was perfectly crisp on the outside but soft and chewy inside — exactly how it should be. The sauce had a nice tang with just the right amount of sweetness, and the cheese was gooey and flavorful without being greasy. I tried the margherita and the pepperoni — both were fresh and loaded with toppings. Staff were friendly, service was quick, and the whole place had a great, cozy vibe. Definitely my new go-to spot for pizza night

Easily one of the best pizza spots around – highly recommend.

On top of that the staff are always friendly and welcoming, which makes the whole experience even better. It’s the kind of place you keep coming back to because you know it won’t disappoint.

Yard sale do the BEST pizzas. Perfect crust every time and they don’t scrimp on the toppings - the Unholy Pepperoni absolutely delicious and positively slathered in pepperoni. Great value for what you get
Came in tonight for a pizza and both the ladies working were suberp! Big shout out to Beth and Toni. Everyone was super friendly, helpful and the food matched with its excellent quality!
The customer service and food was excellent. Will definitely order again. Keep up the good work team, thank you for making my experience so special.

name: 107 Wine Bar
address: 107 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 0NP, UK

reviews.text: Such fantastic food and wine. Sadly let down by the incredibly long wait time for each dish and very small portions. Quite a drip feeding style and maybe done to make you drink more wine. But 5 stars because those things can be fixed and more places like this should exist.

We had a bizarre night here. After being seated by one, very lovely, waiter, another server came over and instructed us to move, he then gave us another seating option, but cited a "15-minute limit" that wasn't mentioned before. The etiquette got even weirder - while we were outside for a moment, that same server actually interrupted my date and me while we were kissing to tell me he’d moved my bag, which I left there to ensure that we were coming back to our seats. We came back in to find he'd given our seats away entirely. Given the context, the whole experience felt targeted, not a nice feeling given it was a queer date. Really disappointing for a wine bar in this area.

2 stars because the wine and food were lovely, shame about his attitude.
One of the best dining experiences I've had in a long while, all the food was delicious, and some of the best wine I've tasted. Would happily come back!
Lovely bolthole serving an eclectic (eccentric?) selection of off the beaten track wines in a cosy venue. Well worth browsing the shelves and settling in for a couple. Excellent poster art too...
Lovely staff and vibe and great selection of wine! The food is as amazing too which is a bonus!

name: Domino's Pizza
address: 113 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 0NP, UK

reviews.text: They did not put any pepperoni on a pepperoni pizza, don't use Domino's as there customers services is totally worthless. It took them almost 6 hrs to respond and only offered to replace the pizza well after.

I recently visited Domino's Pizza in Clapton, and it was a fantastic experience! The food was delicious, and everything we ordered was fresh and flavorful. The pizza had the perfect crust, and the toppings were generous and tasty.
What stood out the most was the staff. They were incredibly friendly and attentive, making us feel welcome from the moment we walked in. Their positive attitude and willingness to help made our visit even more enjoyable.
Overall, I highly recommend Domino's Pizza Clapton for anyone looking for great pizza and excellent service. I can’t wait to go back!

The pizza was delicious, delivery was quick, and everything was well packaged. I want to give a special shout-out to Ovidiu, an exceptional employee – always polite, attentive, and professional. He truly made the experience better. Highly recommended!👍🏻👍🏻

Ordered  2 pizzas, 1 was correct, 1 wasn't. Phoned up and explained the situation, was told the only way I would get a refund or a replacement would be to wait for someone to come and collect the incorrect pizza. Explained that it was 21:15, by the time they got me a new pizza it would be too late, but they would only give me a refund if they could collect the incorrect pizza. At this point it's either eat an incorrect pizza or wait very late for a correct one. Not happy at all.

Called in yesterday at 22:30 to place an order and I clearly asked at the beginning of the call if it’s possible to place an order for collection and the man asked me straight away what I want. I wanted to place an order for 3 medium pizzas and a portion of chicken wings but when I started saying what I’d like on my 3rd pizza the man on the phone yelled at me saying “you’re ordering too much food!” So to clarify, I asked if this means he’s not going to take my order then?! He told me they were closing at 11 o’clock and that I can order online because they aren’t supposed to accept cash payments at this time in store. After telling him that I’ll just order elsewhere he said that it’s fine, he can take my order but the total has already come to £50 and carried on telling me that it’s a lot of food and a lot of money! Again I told him I will order elsewhere, thanked him and ended the call.
A few minutes later he called me back, apologised “for this” and asked what I wanted to order but I told him that I don’t want to order anymore because clearly it bothered him and that I will order elsewhere.

name: Blend Cafe Ltd
address: HBC Centre, Barnabas Rd, London E9 5SD, UK

name: Caribbean-Kitchen
address: Caribbean Kitchen, 67 Mare St, London E8 4RG, UK

reviews.text: My go-to spot in hackney. Easily one of the best caribbean restaurants in London. Lovely people as well! Every dish is 11/10.

It is always good to discover a new neighbourhood favourite, and Caribbean Kitchen know good food! We got a few different things to share take away - jerk chicken, jerk pork, and a goat curry. They were all delicious, even the rice was deeply flavourful. While we didn’t order them, they had plenty of vego options too. Generous large serves that are enough to keep you going all day and lovely service to top it off :-)
Food is always on point. You'll be sure to have your Oxtail so soft it falls off of the bone. They serve a stellar Guinness Punch too. No complaints! Be sure to try everything.

Went there last week based on a friend recommendation and was not disaapointed. the lovely lady behind the counter was super helpful and accomodating. The menu is simple and easy to understand and the portion sizes are very good. Will definitely return. 5 stars from me!!

⭐☆☆☆☆

I recently purchased a bag from Too Good To Go, expecting to receive surplus food that was still good to eat. Unfortunately, this was my third attempt at this particular store, and I was deeply disappointed again. The items I received were burnt and of poor quality, which is not what I anticipated. I understand the mission behind reducing food waste, but the condition of the food was unacceptable. I won’t be returning to this store again, as it seems they are not meeting the standard expected from the Too Good To Go service.

Found this lovely spot on Google Maps after having a very looong day enjoying our trip in London. We fell in love with the interior and the vibes right away. The staff was extremely nice and helpful explaining the menü. We chose to sit in the window seat to enjoy the view of Broadway Market. Dinner was beautifully presented. The falafel was so tasty and the tahini-date-pistachio flatbread is something we need to go back for, simply amazing! We loved everything about this place and honestly cannot wait to dine here again
The most delicious vegetarian and vegan dishes. So flavourful! Such a cute cosy spot with the loveliest owners/staff! Delicious drinks too!
It was a very, very sweet place. The falafel was delicious, I didn't regret eating it. The music was one of the things that made the place familiar for me.

We had a great dinner at this lovely - cosy place on Broadway market Saturday evening. Third time visiting and once again, very inspired by tasty food that is nicely presented and full of flavour. Service is great too. However, I must comment on a very poor sound system which is basically one speaker in the corner that visitors are trying to overpower with their voices and it makes the whole place really noisy as narrow interior.. previously I asked for music to be turned down and they were always sweet and helpful. Overall experience was good and will be coming again.

Fantastic little veggie place in Hackney. All dishes were delicious and it was easy to see all the thought and care put into them. The environment is also super casual, which I loved. A seat to watch life happen on Broadway market, and gorgeous delicious food is all I could've asked for!
It was simply perfect. Order anything in the menu and you will taste delicious food. It’s been 5 years since last time I came here and glad glad glad they maintain good service and food.

I would literally eat here everyday if I could.
Friendly and accommodating staff, dog friendly which is always a huge bonus, really nice atmosphere and good vibes. The food is bloody incredible, I literally have dreams about the courgette flower, the tortilla was great, and generally a really good selection of veggie options, which is actually a pleasant surprise for a tapas place! It’s a little pricey but worth it in my opinion!

came here because i was craving a spanish (croquettes) and randomly found this place, i was pleasantly surprised! the food was super yummy and service was great! food came very promptly and the waiters were very attentive. would definitely recommend coming here.

My third time here!
As Spanish person who is always   looking for nice Spanish food I found this place last year and always came back for arroz negro! Everything I have had is very tasty .
Thank you very much all the time for the service and tasty food , specially to Efe who took care of us. Great way of spending last day of the year. See you in 2026!!!

The staff at El Ganso was so kind and accommodating for my birthday dinner. We were 11 total and had the tasting menu, which was such a great option for us. Because of different dietary needs, they were able to swap out some of options for the folks at our table. The food was tasty, and the portions were generous! We were able to get refills on any of the tapas we wanted.

name: Clapton Table
address: 159 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 8EQ, UK

reviews.text: A fabulous find in Clapton where I was picking up a book from Pages. We had the most delicious brunch, at a cute corner table where we could chat while watching the world go by. Great coffee, very friendly service and really tasty food. The chorizo was so good we had to ask for an extra helping!

I had a very late brunch on a Saturday.
The food is high quality, and reasonably priced.
The service is great: the waiter that served me was very attentive and nice. He knew how to read the room and didn't ask much, while I saw him having a brief chitchat with other costumers.
The atmosphere was very relaxed and my breakfast dish, and chai latte were spot on!
The 'table breakfast' was delicious and the food tasted great, the chai latte sweet the right amount (how I like it).
Unfortunately I am not local, but will definitely try, and come for more! 🙂

Stayed in London round the corner for one night and found this place online. Really good fresh food and the staff are friendly and helpful. Had the beef & chicken burger on the night and came back for the full English the next morning and all were very tasty. The decor in there is lovely as well.

Visiting and one of our neighbours suggested this place for breakfast and we are so glad we came. We had the Turkish eggs and a small kebab plate. The Turkish eggs were so good! It was flavourful, the garlic yogurt was delicious and sourdough bread to clean your plate was well needed! Food, drinks, and service were all perfect! Highly recommend (:

I love this place - great staff and food (club sandwich and lamb kofta are special. My daughter was basically raised here and Farouk and team still accommodate her pancake requests even if it’s not breakfast time. Plus, check out the froth art!

Can't fault this place. Met a friend for some drinks and a burger as I've wanted to try the burgers here for a long time and I wasnt disappointed. The burger was juicy, succulent and very well seasoned. Perfectly toasted bun and the the toppings really "topped" it off. The skin on fries were also very well seasoned and very very moreish. I wish I ordered the loaded fries or a side of chicken as I was still hungry after. Another option would be to double up the burgers to make it a bit more filling. Maybe I'm just greedy. Either way the burger was delicious. The atmosphere in the pub was electric due to the rugby on the TV. Also the football was on another. The daily happy hour was a nice touch aswell between 6 and 7pm every day where selective drinks are a little cheaper. I would definitely go back to try a different burger and the loaded fries

Spectacular chicken burger and crispy potatoes from in-house Lagom team here!! Came for the quiz, which is super busy (and buzzing), didn't expect such delicious food. I'll be back for more another day...

Beautiful place full of good vibes. The staff are amazing and very welcoming.
Fabio made our experience unique with his energetic and smiling personality.
Recommend to everyone to try this pub.

First time here and the goal was  trying out eatlagom, menu  was relatively small compared to  some other burger spots ive been to but to no fault of there own as i could see that the kitchen was quite small so having rotating menu was the best option in terms of what there working with.

im only going to talk about the burgers though the potatos are good.

the lamb burger was cooked as it should be was nice tender and flavourful with a mix medally of flavours with the sauces and peppers used it really cam across as an elevated kebab in a bun.

the fish burger was also great no fish o fillet vibes  here just a nice tenders almost melty fish in your mouth witha crunchy batter and great tartar sauce that pushed everything up a notch with out just being carried by the sauce.

I hope to return again when they have the spice bag and brisket.

4.5 burgers out of 5 only a half star off due to no mention of the rotating menu id recommend having the days/weeks options mentioned somewhere either by instagram announcement. or some variation of the qr code menu with actively being at location.

My favourite pub / bar in Hackney and hold on, in London - heck maybe the world. I love this place, the staff always say hello when you come in and it has a cosy yet exciting vibe if you're there on the weekends. If you're looking for a perfect pub don't miss 3C!

name: My Neighbours the Dumplings - Clapton
address: 165 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 8EQ, UK

reviews.text: my favourite place in London! (As almost Londoner) - the staff are so lovely, the food is absolutely insane - feels like travelling to a different world, a yummy fantasy  - the duck special is absolutely insane. All dumplings are so good! And very pretty! ✨🩷🥟🥟🥟🥟

the pork belly is really crispy and tender, well cooked! and the prawn fried dumplings has this unique green seafood sauce, quite unique but surprisingly works well. its not you usual traditional dumplings.

The food was lovely — everything we ordered was really well done and full of flavour.

A small point, but our table felt quite cramped. We were 3 people on a table really designed for 2, up against the kitchen wall. Dishes were placed down wherever there was space and things felt a little squeezed in, which took away slightly from what could have felt like a more special experience. Given that most of the dishes are sharing, and we had booked in advance so they knew the size of our party, it felt very tight.

More importantly, when we arrived we were told there was a time limit on the table. That in itself is absolutely fine, but when I told our waitress that this should be made clear before at the time of booking - as we only found out about the time limit after we booked - she told us quite firmly that this information had been made clear beforehand. It actually isn’t and only appeared after we had entered our card details to secure the reservation - so too late to cancel without a penalty. It wasn’t visible prior to that - but she wouldn’t believe us.

As it happened, we were able to stay a little longer, which we really appreciated as we were meeting a friend visiting London whom we hadn’t seen in a year. But the initial insistence that we had been informed — when we hadn’t — wasn’t handled particularly well.

Just something to be mindful of: there is a 1 hour 45 minute table limit, which will suit most people, but if you’re planning a longer catch-up, it’s worth being aware in advance.

This place has been on my list for a while and I happened to be in the area yesterday so finally visited. The menu is very extensive with a lot of great things and new things to try. The waiter was so friendly and informative regarding the menu as my friend has an allergy and he knew straight away everything that she could and couldn’t eat which is so refreshing to see. The food itself was amazing, everything we ate was so delicious and great value for money. I’d definitely come back just for those lamb noodles!

I’ve visited this restaurant several times since it first opened, but this was the first time we were given a time limit (about 90 minutes).

The time limit itself wasn’t an issue. However, given that constraint, I felt the food took far too long to arrive. When the dishes finally came out, they were all slightly cold. As a result, we had to finish many of the dishes in the last 30–40 minutes, which felt rushed and didn’t pair well with the cocktail we had ordered at the beginning of the meal.

The pork dish served at the end was also too large, and we ended up leaving some of it. I wish the staff had offered a bit of guidance when we placed the order. In terms of both flavor and texture, it’s a dish that likely divides opinion, and unfortunately it wasn’t to my taste.

Although we were told toward the end that we didn’t need to worry about the time, it didn’t fully erase the frustration of waiting so long for the food earlier in the meal.

Having visited several times over the years, I would say that two things remain unchanged: the shrimp shumai wrappers are still not quite right, while the Madame Butterfly cocktail continues to be excellent.

name: Stone Cave
address: 111 Kingsland High St, London E8 2PB, UK

reviews.text:
Stone Cave Restaurant exceeded our expectations in every possible way. From the moment you walk in, you’re struck by the amazing atmosphere—colorful, exotic lamps hanging from the ceiling create a warm, almost magical ambiance that immediately makes you feel comfortable.
The staff is exceptionally friendly, attentive, and courteous without ever being intrusive. Service was also impressively fast; the food arrived very quickly without compromising quality.
The food was simply outstanding—the best we’ve had in a very long time. The quality of the meat is excellent: incredibly tender, perfectly cooked, and mildly seasoned, allowing all the different flavors to truly stand out. Every bite was balanced and full of taste. Portion sizes are impressively generous, and everything was cooked exactly to perfection.
We also tried the non-alcoholic cocktails, which were among the best we’ve had compared to many other bars—fresh, creative, and full of flavor. To top it all off, we were pleasantly surprised with a complimentary Turkish tea at the end, a small but thoughtful gesture that perfectly rounded off the experience.
Overall, Stone Cave is an absolute gem and a must-visit for anyone who appreciates outstanding food, great service, and a unique atmosphere. We will definitely be back.

lovely experience here! The food came promptly, the service was so good that as soon as we finished a plate, they cleared it up. We particularly enjoyed the chicken pasta with chillies, such a good balance of taste. The brownies were warm, soft and nice with the soft scoop. Complimentary Turkish tea to pair it with too. Definitely recommend. Interior very unique and song choice too!

This is such a lovely cafe so reasonably priced too,  including a free tea with your breakfast which is non existent these days. Decor is fun and makes you feel like your somewhere else would definitely recommend it's a hidden gem, lots of insta photo opportunities inside too. Staff are so lovely and welcoming which always makes a visit worthwhile 😍

This place is exceptional. Super friendly, polite staff, excellent food. I had the cave breakfast and we shared a side of sautéed mushrooms and spicy potatoes. Ambience nice too. The waiter Tolga was lovely and very efficient - checking in on us.

Love the food here. The atmosphere is nice and quite quiet but its only because everytime I've eaten here there aren't many people around. The staff are attentive and fantastic at recommending dishes to try. Location is good not far from Dalston Kingsland Overground station.

Great food and a lot of wine options to choose from. The dishes were all incredibly tasty though I did find a few of them to be quite similar.
cozy atmosphere and Friendly staff as well.
The food was really good especially the fish. It was very fresh. They grilled it nicely with crispy skin. We love all the food we ordered.

Had a great experience here, the wines are amazing and the food was good too!

Minor points on the food but some of the dishes like the fish one had mayo instead of a sauce which didn’t really make sense to have and the beans with the chicken could have been more a mash or a creamier texture, the pie was the highlight though

A  cute and cosy restaurant with an open-plan kitchen, letting diners watch the chefs at work. The food was delicious and creative, with prices on the higher side.

One thing to note: I was simply taking photos of the overall ambience of the open kitchen, not of any specific chef or sous chef, when a team member tapped my shoulder to say I needed permission. While polite, it felt a bit passive- aggressive, especially since the open kitchen is clearly meant to be the highlight of the restaurant and part of the experience.

Given that the beautifully decorated open kitchen is a key reason people visit, as seen in countless reviews (eg. Google, TikTok, Instagram, etc) this rule felt out of place and left an odd vibe.
10/10 food, 10/10 service, 10/10 vibes. Sit on the kitchen island. The farro dish is one of the best things we’ve eaten in a long time. Great options for vegi. We left full and tipsy.

name: The Spread Eagle
address: 224 Homerton High St, London E9 6AS, UK

reviews.text:
🚇 Homerton
🍺 £6.70 Pillars Pilsner

The Spread Eagle is located on Homerton High Street in Hackney, East London. The nearest station is Homerton.

This pub has a history stretching back to 1752. The pub you see today was built in the late 19th century. Originally called The Jackdaw & Stump, It was renamed The Jackdaw & Star in 2014. Following a refurbishment in 2018, the pub was renamed The Spread Eagle.

This is a good-sized, one-bar pub with traditional decor and a few contemporary, funky touches. A large island servery with a copper counter dominates the bar area, with seating at the front, right, and back. There are stools and a drinking ledge on the left. Off the back of the main bar is a pool room, and at the rear there is a cosy, leafy beer garden.

The decor consists of a boarded and tiled floors, petrol blue walls, an eclectic mix of framed photos, a simple ornate fireplace, and an eagle mural. The pool room is superb and acts as a shrine to music legend Prince. The area is bathed in purple UV light, has “Prince” wallpaper, and even a glass cabinet dedicated to him.

The beer selection is all on keg and features a range of local independent brews, plus Guinness. I decided on a Pillars Pilsner, my pint was excellent, price point was above average. The food menu is vegan, the pub prides itself on being London’s first fully vegan pub. The kitchen runs a seasonal menu, working directly with foragers and local producers to recreate pub classics.

I arrived at 5pm on a bright late afternoon in February. The pub was busy throughout, with a good mix of punters, most were imbibing, a few were enjoying some food.. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, so settling in was very easy. The service was friendly, and the team member who served me was upbeat and courteous

To be fair, I expected a food-led vegan gastropub and was pleasantly surprised to find a fantastic, elegant local with an excellent beer range that simply happens to serve food. I thoroughly enjoyed my time here — I love that pool room.

📅 28th February 2026
Amazing pub with a fantastic atmosphere and super friendly staff. Great to see it so busy on a sunday. Food was absolutely top dollar. And the hot chocolate was soooooo flavoursome.

Went for a Sunday roast and it was spectacular. Beet Wellington was umami and a perfect centrepiece, the roasties were crispy, the veg were cooked perfectly, and the gravy was plentiful. Shared a side of cheesy leek gratin which was unctuous and I would heartily recommend.
Also shared a bottle of red wine
Staff are all happy, friendly and helpful. Amazing vegan pub.

Had an amazing roast dinner here. We both got the nut roast which was so yummy and the roast potatoes were cooked to perfection! They have generous servings and the meal was very filling. We were served by Danielle who was super lovely.

It's a cute vibe, bartenders are really helpful and kind. Will definitely come back again for a chilled evening. Unfortunately we missed out on Karaoke and the 2 for 1 happy hour! We had to meet some more friends elsewhere. However we've all said we will return for another evening.
The food was quite mid, me and my friend ordered a beef burger to share which was incredibly underwhelming, however the chips where absolutely amazing! Played some pool while we waited for food, had a few drinks. Overall a good pre-drink.

name: GAIL's Bakery Victoria Park
address: Victoria Park, 87 Lauriston Rd, London E9 7HL, UK

reviews.text: My absolute favourite team in East London! I'm there every single morning and they make my day every time. :-) I don't know what more you can ask from your baristas/ bakery team. I genuinely look forward to seeing them every day because I know that it's a guaranteed smile right there and then. Thank you so much!! I don't take you for granted. :-)

The staff here are cheerful and friendly but professional at all times, despite being so busy. Good tea and coffee and tasty snacks. The potato and rosemary sourdough is particularly delicious. Anisah was very helpful with snack suggestions. A great spot to recharge one's batteries after a park walk.0

The customer service at GAIL’s Victoria Park is honestly second to none. It’s not just good once, it’s consistently amazing every single time I visit with my family. All the staff are so smiley, friendly, and genuinely high-vibe people, which makes such a difference. The whole place has such a lovely, wholesome feel to it. You always feel welcome and looked after. Just a really beautiful vibe all round!

I recently visited the Victoria Park branch and had a good experience. This small location often has long queues, so I recommend using the app to pre-order your drinks and items.

I used the app to order an iced matcha with cucumber and elderflower, along with a blueberry and custard brioche bun for collection in advance. However, it still took a while for my order to be prepared and handed to me.

On the positive side, the staff at this location were very friendly, and there is a nice selection of sandwiches, baked goods, and desserts available.

very friendly and welcoming staff. our pastries were good, usual Gail's (high) standard. unfortunately our long black coffee were very poor (too much water and too high water temperature - basically destroyed all aroma). we were seated in the narrow passage leading to the back garden, and we had to get up every few minutes to let someone out/in. plus, it's full of dogs (sorry, I love them, but not indoors, not seating on the chairs next to the, literally touching).

name: Pivaz
address: 34 Chatsworth Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 0LP, UK

reviews.text: Superb food in a lovely restaurant. Baba ghanoush outstanding for starter, then a chicken sarma and a sutlach (rice pudding) dessert. Thanks to Baris and the team for an exceptional meal.

We had a wonderful evening at Pivaz! The food was absolutely delicious – full of flavour, beautifully presented, and with generous portions. The atmosphere was warm and relaxed, with both indoor and outdoor seating that created a great vibe.

What truly made the visit special was the owner/waiter. He took his time with each customer, was friendly, attentive, and genuinely cared about making sure everyone had a good experience. People like him are rare – and they make all the difference.

Highly recommended – we’ll definitely be coming back!

We had dinner at Pivaz Hackney tonight, and it was a fantastic experience! Our waitress, Nico, was incredibly sweet and attentive—her service was truly exceptional. She made sure everything was perfect for us and added a special touch to our evening. The service was quick, the staff was friendly, and the cozy ambiance made the night even more enjoyable. The portion sizes were generous, and everything was delicious. Huge thanks to the whole team for a wonderful night

Delicious dinner and a wonderful atmosphere! A special thanks to Lena — she was incredibly attentive, kind, and always smiling. She truly made our evening even better. Thank you for the warm welcome — we’ll definitely be back 💛

100% recommended!
I came for lunch and ended up staying for coffee.
The food was very filling and absolutely delicious (grilled chicken with salad, plus bread with red and garlic sauce), and the coffee was just perfect — a mocha with oat milk.
On top of that, Alex, the waiter, was very attentive and helpful.
I’ve just moved to the area, and I’m sure this will become my go-to place!
Thank you so much 😊

name: OMBRA
address: 1 Vyner St, Bethnal Green, London E2 9DG, UK

reviews.text:
We had the most wonderful Sunday lunch at Ombra. From the first snack through to dessert, every dish was authentic, beautifully prepared, and bursting with flavour — true Italian cooking at its best. The girolle mushroom tagliolini was delicate and full of depth, the monkfish main was perfectly cooked and full of flavour, and the apricot, mint and yoghurt dessert was a refreshing finish. Compliments to Chef Alessandro, whose skill and passion really shone through in every plate.
For drinks, we trusted our waiter Red, who paired each dish with the perfect wine recommendation. Each glass lifted the food even further, and it made the whole meal feel carefully curated.
We enjoyed it all out on the sunny terrace, where the relaxed, welcoming atmosphere made it a truly memorable family lunch. Ombra delivered on every level — excellent food, thoughtful service, and a beautiful setting. We’ll definitely be back!

I’ve been here a couple of times before but this was the first time in a few years even if I’ve eaten my body weight in maritozzi and semolina sourdough in their bakery opposite, Forno.

The whole afternoon was honestly lovely: plate after plate arrived and everything was exquisite: courgette flowers, prosciutto, aubergine caponata, the ravioli, the tagliatelli with girolles, etc. The marzipan semifreddo was genius and the only thing in the whole meal that didn’t quite hit the spot for us was the panna cotta which seemed heavier than I’m used to.

Service was super attentive throughout, requests for wine recommendations stayed at the top of the list rather than heading to the bottom and the interior is quirky and welcoming. Although by mid-October the canal is no longer that draw that it would be in June, it’s a great location.

In a city with a never ending supply of restaurants, all four of us agreed we’d be delighted to return here. Such good food, such lovely heart. 🥰 Thanks, all.

I took my parents here for lunch , it was their first time and only my second time. Absolutely impeccable! We had the chef’s menu for 3 with wine pairing. Big shoutout to Phil (certified sommelier) for perfectly pairing every unique dish.

**Oysters with blood orange and olive oil
**Olive oil, lemon mussels with fennel
**Grilled White asparagus with sardines
**Gnocco fritto (house staple!)
**Lamb’s heart on whipped feta (!!)
**Fresh pasta (made daily on-site) with beef shin ragù
**Basil & raspberry cake (mind-blowing flavourrrr)
**Tiramisu (rightly praised as London’s best.  My mum demolished it solo!)

The team at Ombra just get it- full of heart, bold flavours, and warming energy.

P.s.: the chefs menu changes with season as they source the freshest ingredients! worth going back!

(To the tune of oompa loompa)

Ombra loompa I am now fat
We got lots of plates now can you top that!!

Ombra loompa doo pa de de
We had a great time now listen to me!!

So myself and my wife came in as she had seen this spot when she visited the last Tuesday society. And oh how pleased I am she saw it.

Tonight we had the chefs menu and it was not only incredible value but an immersive culinary experience. The staff were very knowledgeable and very attentive but the food really was the winner of the evening. I never knew asparagus could taste soo good!!

The tasting menu allowed us to try food we would never usually choose such as the lambs heart but honestly it’s worth every bite.
Great Sunday lunch plenty of delicious and unusual dishes, lovely combination of flavours and attentive service, a must try.

name: Chestersway Chicken Clapton
address: 179 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 8EQ, UK

reviews.text: Verry nice food and fresh highly recommend their burgers and chicken wings their perri perri chicken and rice is also really nice 😊

Chesterway chicken in Hackney was one of the worst food experiences I’ve ever had. The moment I opened the box, I had a bad feeling — the food looked sloppy, smelled off, and tasted even worse. And unfortunately, my instincts were right. After eating it, I ended up feeling violently sick. I’m talking extreme stomach pains and a miserable night that I would not wish on anyone.

I can’t say what the issue was, but whatever I ate did not sit right at all, and it was honestly one of the most unpleasant reactions I’ve ever had to a meal. The whole thing felt like a complete waste of money and a health gamble I deeply regret taking.

I will absolutely never order from this place again, and based on my own experience, I’d strongly recommend avoiding it

I remember this place when it used to be called Sam's many years ago so was interested to see if it would still be any good. Ordered hash browns and they were absolutely divine! My friend ordered a burger and was equally impressed. The gentleman at the front was friendly, funny and honestly made our night - we need more people like him in the world :)
Wow amazing food, amazing price, amazing service. What more can anyone asked for at 2:20am!!!
Very tasty halal burger, Highly recommended.

name: Yeast Bakery
address: Unit 1, Canal Place, 1-3 Sheep Ln, London E8 4QS, UK

reviews.text: Nice place slightly tucked away near Broadway Market so they weren't full. Lots of interesting cakes and pastries. We had the French Toast at £14.95 which is overpriced for the area. The toast and maple syrup itself was great but it comes with nothing. Everywhere else I've had french toast serves it with fruit. Given the price it needs to be more than just toast and syrup

This place is absolutely beautiful, located right next to a canal. I had the cheese and onion toastie, a cinnamon bun and a cappuccino, also picked up an almond croissant. Everything was lovely, and the service was incredible. The owner and barista are two absolute sweethearts who made us feel so welcome. Definitely recommend treating yourself to this place.

The best bakery in London and I’ve been to the many of the alleged top 10. Incredible food, service and the decor is gorgeous. It’s a family run business with an amazing story. I’ve tried both the brunch and newly opened bistro which is a must. Everything we had was exception. Make sure to get the oxtail croquets, Sirloin steak, layered potatoes and chocolate tart!

We came to the Bistro on a Saturday night for our anniversary and had a lovely experience. The owners were so nice, a family-run business, and the food was spectacular. The steak with chimichurri was a standout, with the layered potatoes a close second. Highly recommend!
Quiet cozy family run cafe. Coffee is great and pastries are a hit and miss. Staff were very friendly

name: Voodoo Ray's Dalston
address: 95 Kingsland High St, London E8 2PB, UK

reviews.text: The three times I have been here pizza has been consistent. It is not cheap but usually a slice will be enough to satiate you if you are not too hungry. The spicy pepperoni was tasty but it would have been nice to have a bit more of pepperoni. Very kind staff from Colombia was working there in my last visit.
I ordered the pizzas from deliveroo and it was my son’s birthday and it arrived cold with barely any toppings on it. I had guests and kids waiting for the pizza it was so disappointing. Avoid

Order a pizza today and hate to say but it was terrible. The delivery was fairly quick so can’t blame it on that, but the pizza tasted really weird the tomato sauce was cold and the cheese cold and lumpy not melted cheesy and the dough was soggy. It actually made me gag, and had to bin it as I didn’t feel safe eating it. I rang the restaurant and let them know and they apologised. That was that. I’ve eaten at VR for over 10 years but I don’t know if I can recover from this, the last pizza I had there was not great either but nothing in comparison to what I had this evening. I am sorry to say but I won’t be eating there again.
Wth😂 what happened here? Ordered hot ananas and there's barely any pineapple on this pizza. More dough than the good stuff for £5.40. naaaahh byeee

Ordered Deliveroo from Voodoo Rays as every time I’ve been in store it has been fantastic.

Unfortunately the food arrived freezing cold, half the garlic bread was missing (assumed it was eaten), one pizza arrived looking as if it had been thrown against a wall inside the box and the other pizza just remarkably average.

Your in store experiences have always been very good, if you choose to do delivery you need to ensure it matches the experience inside the restaurant (or at least close to) regardless of whether it is yourselves or Deliveroo.

name: Souvlakiland
address: 199A Homerton High St, London E9 6BB, UK

reviews.text: It's not about the atmosphere; this is essentially a kebab shop. But it is such a good one. I got the chicken gyros and it was deeply enjoyable. It tasted like properly roasted chicken with some nice crispy bits but overall very juicy and not at all greasy. The bread is freshly made and very soft, the salad is crisp and the tazatzki is somehow thick and light. I almost shed a tear...

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
We had an amazing experience at Souvlaki Land London! The food was absolutely delicious — real authentic Greek taste, fresh, and full of flavor. The portions were generous, and everything was cooked perfectly. The chef was such a kind and friendly person, always smiling and welcoming. The place was very clean and well-kept, with great attention to hygiene.
Definitely a 10 out of 10 experience — highly recommended! 🇬🇷👏

Basic but delicious!! A real hidden gem of a spot in Hackney. The souvlaki wraps are always fresh and stuffed to the brim with meat and toppings, and the owner is always cheerful and friendly. A great quick lunch option, I’ve been coming regularly for the past several years so thought it was about time I left a review.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
One of my favourite spots in Hackney! I got a pork and chicken gyros with halloumi and it was absolutely delicious. The owner was super friendly and even gave me an extra piece of chicken, which I sat down and enjoyed before taking my gyros home. I don’t even live in Hackney but I always make sure to stop by whenever I’m in the area — the gyros here remind me of when I was actually in Greece. Highly recommend!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Souvlaki Land London was a wonderful experience! The food was delicious with very generous portions – totally worth it. The place was super clean, and everything looked well taken care of. The chef was extremely friendly and made us feel very welcome. Definitely coming back again! 🇬🇷🥙👏

name: story deli
address: 515 Cambridge Heath Rd, London E2 9BU, UK

reviews.text: Definitely one of the best pizzas I’ve ever had, maybe the best. Loved the crust and the texture of the pizzas, and the seasoning was just amazing. We had the Florentine, prawn, and Hackney Hoo, and honestly each one had its own unique seasoning and personality. The prawn pizza was my favourite, especially the mix of a little spice and vinegar, absolutely incredible. The lemon cheesecake was also unreal, loved the texture and the combo of lemon, ice cream (maybe?) and a bit of yogurt. Honestly, just speechless. Will definitely be back for more. The owners are super friendly and funny, a 12 out of 10 experience!😍

I think this might be my favourite find in London! Not only was the food incredible (and definitely recommend the coffee cheesecake), but the hosts were so lovely and the atmosphere and interior just felt really authentic and tranquil - the shared table vibe is really lovely. And can’t not mention Dottie and Freckle, the most gorgeous mummy and baby beagle duo! Will definitely be back!

Had an absolutely incredible experience at story deli. The cozy restaurant has caught our eyes every time we walk by on Cambridge Heath. We were not disappointed when we finally stopped in. Our hosts were so welcoming, the adorable dog sleeping on the sofa was so charming, and they went out of their way to make us feel at home. The pizzas we're delicious and so unique combinations of flavors. Must try.

Their precious takeaway packages was also charming, truly every moment with this place was a delight.

Such a unique experience in a quirky, crafty place. It felt like you were at a dining room of a country cottage, where vintage, handmade items were dotted around the space in poetic randomness. The owners were hospitable and friendly, the food was organic, beautiful, fresh and tasty, and the beagle was a plus. Even the leftover was packed like a gift. We were lucky to be the only guests for the whole evening. Will 10/10 be back when the fabled tiramisu is back on the menu!
